items.title: NYSE’s Chris Bergan Explains Why Large Caps are Transferring to the NYSE
items.summary:
NYSE Director of Listings Chris Bergin joins NYSE Live to discuss why a growing number of high-profile companies are choosing to transfer their listings to the New York Stock Exchange.

The conversation follows Kraft Heinz's transfer to the NYSE and explores broader listing trends, including recent moves by companies such as AstraZeneca, Fifth Third Bancorp, and Skydance. Bergin discusses the factors companies evaluate when considering an exchange transfer, including visibility, liquidity, market structure, and access to the NYSE's unique trading floor ecosystem.

He also explains the role of Designated Market Makers (DMMs) in the NYSE's market model, how the exchange supports listed companies through advisory services and capital markets resources, and why financial institutions continue to make the NYSE their listing venue of choice.

Watch NYSE Live for insights into capital markets, exchange listings, and the trends shaping the public company landscape.

items.title: Wall Street Guru Jay Woods Breaks Down Mechanics of Kraft Heinz Transfer to NYSE
items.summary:
Freedom Capital Markets Chief Market Strategist Jay Woods joins NYSE Live from the floor of the New York Stock Exchange as Kraft Heinz celebrates its transfer to the NYSE.

Woods discusses the value of the NYSE's trading floor model, highlighting the role of market makers in supporting listed companies through market insight, liquidity, and direct engagement during periods of volatility. He explains why companies may view the NYSE as a long-term home and reflects on the exchange's history, visibility, and market structure advantages.

The conversation also turns to broader market themes, including artificial intelligence, data center investment trends, market breadth, sector rotation, inflation, Federal Reserve policy, and geopolitical developments. Woods shares his perspective on recent market volatility and discusses how investors are evaluating leadership within the technology sector amid an evolving market environment.
